one_liner: Ranks every number by its chance of returning now under its own mix of four return patterns, fitted to its gaps within the last 208 draws.
registry_status_reason: Released by package REL-1 (releases and WF-1 design v0.1r1, owner decisions WF1-1 and WF1-2, ratified 31 October 2026). Contract runs on real data need the separate real-development gate.
short_explanation: E_18 looks at how long each number has been away since it was last drawn. It describes each number's gaps between appearances (its gaps within the last 208 draws) as a mix of four fixed patterns: quick returns, fair returns, long absences and evenly spaced returns, fitted exactly and pulled towards the fair pattern by 10 fair gaps. Each number scores its chance of returning now under its mix. It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its scores are not chances, so no probabilities are published. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 208 earlier draws. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
